# SYNESIS_E016 — Error

## Description

Bundle (example_a, example_b): missing fields `example_b`.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The fields `example_a, example_b` form an indivisible bundle in this block
  — they represent compound information and must always appear together.
  One or more bundle fields are missing: `example_b`.
  Add the missing fields or remove all fields of the bundle.
  A partial bundle is not valid.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **MissingBundleField**: `bundle_fields`, `present_fields`
